class.name: IfcEngine
class.brief_description: An engine is a device that converts fuel into mechanical energy through combustion. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcEngine defines the occurrence of any engine; common information about engine types is handled by IfcEngineType . The IfcEngineType (if present) may establish the common type name, usage (predefined type), properties, materials, ports, composition, assignments, and
